In particular the component containing vertex n is not a simple tree and cannot receive the asserted proper two-colouring with opposite signs on the loop.","load_bearing":"The subsequent signed-sum estimate requires the component containing n to be a loopless tree so that every paired edge has oppositely signed endpoints.
